app.title: MediSaarthi
app.tagline: AI-Powered Multilingual AYUSH Patient Intake & Clinical History System
app.disclaimer: Clinical intake and triage assistance only. Does not diagnose diseases or replace medical practitioners.

landing.heroSubtitle: Convert patient voice and text conversations into structured clinical histories, detect urgent red-flags, and equip doctors with verified clinical timelines.
landing.step1Desc: Patient interacts naturally in Hindi or English using voice or keyboard.
landing.step2Desc: Extracts clinical symptoms, duration, severity, and medications into structured data.
landing.step3Desc: Adaptive interview engine decides the next targeted question without rigid 40-question forms.
landing.step4Desc: Deterministic red-flag safety rules halt routine questioning and flag life-threatening cases.
landing.step5Desc: Organizes chief complaint, HPI, past history, and AYUSH constitutional parameters.
landing.step6Desc: Physician reviews, edits, and verifies clinical record with complete audit logs.

consent.title: Clinical Intake Notice & Patient Consent
consent.body: This AI-assisted intake system collects and organizes your medical symptoms to assist the consulting healthcare professional. It is an intake assistant and does NOT provide medical diagnosis, nor does it replace professional evaluation.

intake.typePlaceholder: Type your symptoms in English or Hindi...
intake.emptyState: Share your symptoms to begin live extraction.

triage.highAlert: HIGH PRIORITY: Potential Urgent Symptoms Detected
triage.highAlertDesc: Severe cardiorespiratory or emergent symptoms detected. Routine intake has been halted.
triage.disclaimer: Automated clinical safety alert, not a definitive diagnosis.
triage.seekCare: Please seek immediate emergency clinical evaluation without delay.
